Observations: each observation has metric (demand/link/ingress/egress), target, [lower, upper] interval, domain (or null = trusted). A domain is faulty iff at least one of its observations (in any snapshot) has true value outside its interval. Trusted observations must be within intervals. Faulty domain count ≤ max_faults; minimize number of faulty domains k. Feasible explanations F = all explanations achieving k.

Then output:
- status unique/ambiguous based on whether all demand entries q[s,c] are identical over F.
- min_faults k.
- faults forced/possible (intersection/union of faulty domain sets over F).
- per-snapshot demands min/max over F for each commodity, links min/max over F for each edge as exact rationals.
- verdict: consistent/inconsistent/undetermined based on controller agreement over F.
- witness: one explanation in F (demands integers, links rationals, faults = actual violated domains).
- alternative: null if unique, else second witness with different demand matrix.
